narrative.overview:
Every release is one issue of a printed programme: a strict two-level grid, a rail that lists the issues, and one huge release numeral that stays put while its issue scrolls. The world is Program Sarajevo '84 meeting Pitaj.io: neutral paper, the logo's near-black ink, a single programme blue, and a signal green reserved for reliability and privacy.

Structure is made of rules, not boxes. A 3px ink rule opens each issue, the masthead and the colophon; 1px hairlines separate rows. One sans family (Archivo, with its width axis) carries all roles; a mono face appears only for code. Light and dark follow the OS.

The build rejects rounded cards, pills, shadows and gradients. Circles are the one round form, and only on conversation-type pictogram tiles.
keyCharacteristics: Flat: no shadows, no gradients, no rounded containers.
3px ink rules for hierarchy, 1px hairlines for rows.
Blue is the single programme colour; green is for infra and privacy only.
Tile shape (circle vs square) and text carry state and category; colour only reinforces.

rules.name: The One Programme Colour Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only accent. Green appears only on reliability and privacy. Do not add a third hue.

rules.name: The Shape Before Hue Rule
rules.body: Category and state are told by tile shape (circle for conversation, square for the rest), a "Novo" word and a square marker, and bold weight on the current rail entry. Colour is never the only signal.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Everything is Archivo; hierarchy comes from weight (400/500/700/900), size and width, never a second text face.

rules.name: The Rules Not Boxes Rule
rules.body: Separate with a rule or whitespace; never with a shadow, border box or fill panel.

dos: Do open each major block with a 3px ink rule and separate rows with 1px hairlines.
Do keep blue as the only accent; use green only for infra and privacy.
Do make sections rows of tile, heading and list, with tile shape as the category signal.
Do use Archivo for everything and keep tabular numerals on.
Do keep text lines to 68ch and the page to 1280px.
Do swap to the dark values through the same custom properties, not new colours.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, pills, shadows or gradients.
Don't introduce a third accent hue or rely on colour alone to mark state.
Don't add a second text typeface; mono is for code only.
Don't add a hero or a "latest" tile that sets the newest release apart from the feed; the numeral in blue is the only mark.
Don't put circles on anything but conversation-type pictogram tiles.
